title: An Empirical Study of the Anchoring Effect in LLMs: Existence, Mechanism, and Potential Mitigations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model numerical estimations and comparative judgments using semantic and numerical priming paradigms via the SynAnchors dataset. The methodology involves calculating the Anchor Index (A-Index) for semantic tasks, measuring Relative Error (R-Error) for numerical tasks, and utilizing causal tracing (activation patching) to analyze internal layer mechanisms.
